name: Nathalie Loiseau - Après le § 22 - Am 11
title: REPORT on EU-Syria political relations
part_text: 22a. Stresses that the return of Syrian nationals must be a priority of EU-Syria relations; calls on the Member States to reassess protection needs in the light of the changed circumstances in Syria and to enforce return decisions where no right to remain exists; urges the Syrian authorities to cooperate fully on the readmission of their nationals and to create the conditions for safe and dignified return;
